inputs.original_text: The IOC has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games, in what it calls a landmark decision to protect fairness and safety. IOC president Kirsty Coventry said: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.”
